claim: A hook must restore the caller's CPU speed, not a fixed 3.5 MHz: read NR 7 first, keep it on the stack or in state, and use a latch per plotter window.

evidence.text: Three latches (plotter, Dizzy plotter, every other hook) because hooks can run inside a plotter's 28 MHz window; NR 7 is read first (51 T, no stack).
Every hook left NR 7 at 3.5 MHz until HK_IN kept the caller's speed on the stack.
Stateless alt-ROM hooks keep the caller's speed on the stack, writing it back at exit.
